**Recommended one-shot formulation:**

- **Ethanol:** **50.0 v/v%**
- **SDS:** **0.75 w/v%**

**Rationale:** The best valid result so far was around **34.56% ethanol / 0.75% SDS → 68.108°**. Since the measured contact angle is still ~3° too high, and ethanol has generally been the component most likely to further reduce contact angle, I would push ethanol to the corrected upper bound while keeping SDS near the best-performing level rather than maxing SDS. This is the most plausible one-shot move toward **65°** within the feasible search space.
